instances.description: List of PostgreSQL instance identifiers to monitor. Each identifier should be a unique name corresponding to a pgBackRest stanza or a comma-separated `host:port:db` tuple (e.g., 'primary,standby').

listen.description: IP address or hostname the exporter should bind to for HTTP requests.

port.description: TCP port on which the exporter exposes Prometheus metrics.

conf_path.description: Absolute path to the main pgBackRest configuration file.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for pgBackRest command completion before timing out.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for the exporter’s metrics endpoint.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file. Required when TLS is enabled.

tls_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file. Required when TLS is enabled.

stanzas.description: Optional list of specific stanza names to query. If empty, all stanzas discovered will be queried.
